summary: Cuentas Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its Warrant Agency Agreement extending the expiration date of publicly traded warrants from June 30, 2026 to September 30, 2026. The warrants were originally issued in a February 2021 unit offering with an initial exercise price of $4.30 per share, subsequently adjusted to $55.90 due to a reverse stock split. The board retains discretion to reduce the exercise price and proportionately increase shares. This is a routine contractual modification without acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation event.
